title: Cartwise+ Membership Period Fee Billing Rules
content:
The billing rules below govern how a Cartwise+ Membership period fee is charged.

**Clause 1 — retired.** "Every paid period is billed once, on its first day, at the plan's period fee." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**Clause 2.** Each fee charge records its fee type: the first period, a renewal, a renewal retry after a decline, or a plan-switch charge.

**Clause 3.** A period runs the plan's period length in calendar months on the plan's billing cycle, and the renewal date is the same day of month as the period start; when that day does not exist in the renewal month, the renewal falls on that month's last day.

**Clause 4.** A fee is charged only while the membership is applied, trialing, active, past due or paused at the moment of the charge. A renewal is not charged for a membership that is pending cancellation or canceled.

**Clause 5.** Taxes are not added to membership fees.

**Clause 6.** The price is the one in force for the plan on the charge date; no plan pays another plan's fee.

## Clause 4 as a status table

| Membership status at the moment of the charge | A fee may be charged? |
|---|---|
| applied | yes |
| trialing | yes |
| active | yes |
| past due | yes |
| paused | yes |
| pending cancellation | no |
| canceled | no |

The status is the one the membership record shows at the moment of the charge.

## Fee types recorded

| Fee type | Recorded when |
|---|---|
| first period | the first paid period starts |
| renewal | a membership rolls into its next paid period |
| renewal retry | a declined fee is captured on a later attempt |
| plan switch | a plan switch starts a new period with a charge |

The period fee and period length of each plan are those in the plan fee schedule.
